security_capabilities_verified: Strict 24-hour customer care window enforcement (OUTSIDE_24H_WINDOW_ERROR for expired/unknown free-form text before external send)
Approved multilingual template message dispatch outside 24h window with components (header, body, buttons)
Perimetral SSRF Guard validation on template header media parameters (rejects internal/metadata IPs before dispatch)
Outbound media support (image, audio without caption, video, document with automatic filename extraction from URL pathname)
Resilient detectMediaType handling query parameters and stripped URL pathnames
Inbound media resolution via getMediaUrl and getMediaMetadata querying GET /v21.0/${mediaId} with bearer auth in scoped secretResolver callback
Numeric phoneNumberId validation prohibiting 'me' and non-numeric fallback
In-flight abort fencing rethrowing FENCING_IN_FLIGHT_ABORT on lease loss
Deterministic Meta error classification (transient 429/130429 with parsed Retry-After, 5xx; permanent 131026, 132000, 190; ambiguous 408, EMPTY_MESSAGE_ID, network timeout)
Inbound media webhook normalization extracting mediaId, mimeType, fileSha256, and filename in metadata
Inbound interactive message normalization for button_reply and list_reply mapping title to body and IDs to metadata
Versioned externalEventId generation (v1:waba:${externalMessageId}:${status}:${epochSec}) and zero status drop

acceptance_criteria.evidence: MetaWabaAdapter.sendMessage rejeita textos livres fora da janela de 24 horas (OUTSIDE_24H_WINDOW_ERROR) e autoriza templates aprovados.
MetaWabaAdapter extrai e envia filename para mensagens de documento e valida componentes de mídia em cabeçalhos de templates contra SSRF.
MetaWabaAdapter.getMediaUrl e getMediaMetadata resolvem mediaId em URL do CDN da Meta através do ISigningSecretResolver sem vazar credenciais.

MetaWabaAdapter classifica deterministamente erros transitórios (429/130429 com Retry-After, 5xx), permanentes (131026, 132000, 190) e ambíguos (408, EMPTY_MESSAGE_ID, timeouts), relançando FENCING_IN_FLIGHT_ABORT em caso de aborto.
WabaWebhookNormalizer extrai metadados completos de mídia (mediaId, mimeType, fileSha256, filename) e normaliza mensagens interativas (button_reply, list_reply).
Suítes channel-adapters.test.ts (30 testes), channel-gateway.test.ts (40 testes) e todos os 6 gates de CI (pnpm ci:gate com 364 asserções) aprovados com 100% de sucesso.
